Hello srela,

Thank you for being part of the Technovation Girls
program. Based on
your location, you have been assigned to eSTEM Morocco.

Technovation Chapters are partner organizations that
run the
Technovation program in a local community or region.
The
Chapter Ambassador is the leader of a Chapter and can
help
guide you through the Technovation program.

We are excited to have you as part of Technovation
Girls!
If you have any questions, please contact us at
support@technovation.org

Thanks,

The Technovation Team

Follow @technovation 
( http://twitter.com/technovation ) on Twitter.

What is a Hi!?

A Hi! is a free, one-word message (Hi!) that a member can send for
free. It lets you know who is interested in communicating with you.

If either you or the sender is a gold member, you can respond with a
custom email here
<http://www.MyLanguageExchange.com/MInfo.asp?uid=4717609#SendEmail> .
If you cannot send a custom email, you can upgrade to gold member here
<http://www.mylanguageexchange.com/Order.asp> .
You can also stay a regular member and respond with a free Hi! of your
own. The sender will know you want to communicate and may decide to
upgrade to a gold member!

To stop receiving Hi!s, please log in here
<http://www.mylanguageexchange.com/HiEdit.asp> .
To stop receiving email notifications, please log in here
<http://www.mylanguageexchange.com/MemberEmailNotifyMe.asp> .

Yesterday=2C we hosted our annual October celebration both at our San Fran=
cisco HQ and online (https://www.youtube.com/live/9tuPzhTqPq8?t=3D514s)=2C=
 highlighting the memories=2C makers=2C and movements that made this achie=
vement possible. The event also explored the future of web preservation=2C=
 sharing how we continue building the web=E2=80=99s collective memory toge=
ther. Highlighted below are some of the fantastic projects launched this y=
ear due to research materials in the Archive=E2=80=94take a look!

Archiving Government Web Pages

Since 2004 (https://eotarchive.org/data/data-2004/)=2C the "End of Term" (=
EOT) Web Archive has documented administrative changes before and after U.=
S. presidential elections. This resource is invaluable for researchers=2C=
 journalists=2C students=2C and citizens seeking to understand shifts in p=
olicy and regulations.

The current EOT crawl for 2024/2025 has collected over 500 terabytes of da=
ta=2C including more than 100 million unique web pages=2C all preserved fo=
r public access via the Internet Archive.

In an increasingly important era for web archiving=2C we are proud to offe=
r this free resource=2C providing essential context on health=2C safety=2C=
 security=2C and education worldwide.

LEARN ABOUT EOT CRAWL: https://eotarchive.org/

Turning All Links Blue

The "Turn All References Blue" (TARB) project at the Internet Archive=2C i=
nitiated in 2020=2C tackles content drift in Wikipedia hyperlinks. TARB en=
sures that every citation from web pages=2C books=2C and papers links to a=
 digital version of the cited resource=2C starting with Wikipedia.

The project identifies and fixes broken web links=2C replacing them with U=
RLs from the Wayback Machine and other archives. It also evaluates citatio=
ns in Wikipedia articles to link to relevant digital resources from the In=
ternet Archive.

In 2021=2C we launched the Wikipedia Citations Database (WCD) using the Wi=
kibase software=2C aiming to represent every citation in the "References"=
 section of Wikipedia articles across 325 language editions. We estimate t=
he database will contain at least 100 million records.

We continue to develop software tools=2C bots=2C and processes to support=
 our efforts.

MORE ABOUT TARB: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3DB0QxZrmBkHI

Web Pages As More Than Just Numbers

The 1 trillion archived web pages represent more than just numbers; they h=
ave a real impact on people's lives=2C research=2C and memory. Whether it'=
s for immigration cases=2C personal histories=2C academic research=2C or i=
nvestigative journalism=2C the Wayback Machine has emerged as an essential=
 public resource that preserves the web for everyone.

* Canadian musician David Samuelrelied on archived concert programs in the=
 Wayback Machine (https://blog.archive.org/2023/06/26/canadian-musician-ut=
ilizes-wayback-machine-for-immigration-documentation/) to secure U.S. resi=
dency.

* Paul Lindnerbuilt a digital memorial (https://blog.archive.org/2020/03/1=
9/love-loss-and-archives/) to his late wife by recovering her online prese=
nce.
* Researchers at King=E2=80=99s College London use web archives totrack th=
e evolution of fake news (https://blog.archive.org/2023/10/09/from-fake-ne=
ws-to-open-data-studying-the-histories-of-digital-media-using-the-wayback-=
machine/) and open data.

* Investigative trainers call the Wayback Machine =E2=80=9Ca precious tool=
=E2=80=9D forexposing deleted evidence (https://blog.archive.org/2023/07/1=
0/preserving-the-past-empowering-the-future-unveiling-the-wayback-machines=
-vital-role-in-investigative-work/).

member=2C research=2C or recover something important? Share Below!

                            <span style=3D"font-size:20px"><strong>Turning=
 All Links Blue</strong></span>

<p dir=3D"ltr" style=3D"color: #2A2A2A;margin: 10px 0;padding: 0;mso-line-=
height-rule: exactly;-ms-text-size-adjust: 100%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:=
 100%;font-family: Helvetica;font-size: 16px;line-height: 150%;text-align:=
 left;">The "<a href=3D"https://archive.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=
=3D38bd6154386f64fcd92204a25&id=3D7a7cd1e013&e=3D464469b4cb" target=3D"_b=
lank" style=3D"mso-line-height-rule: exactly;-ms-text-size-adjust: 100%;-w=
ebkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;color: #0baadf;font-weight: normal;text-decor=
ation: underline;">Turn All References Blue</a>" (TARB) project at the Int=
ernet Archive=2C initiated in 2020=2C tackles content drift in Wikipedia h=
yperlinks. TARB ensures that every citation from web pages=2C books=2C and=
 papers links to a digital version of the cited resource=2C starting with=
 Wikipedia.<br>
<br>
The project identifies and fixes broken web links=2C replacing them with U=
RLs from the Wayback Machine and other archives. It also evaluates citatio=
ns in Wikipedia articles to link to relevant digital resources from the In=
ternet Archive.<br>
<br>
In 2021=2C we launched the Wikipedia Citations Database (WCD) using the Wi=
kibase software=2C aiming to represent every citation in the "References"=
 section of Wikipedia articles across 325 language editions. We estimate t=
he database will contain at least 100 million records.<br>
<br>
We continue to develop software tools=2C bots=2C and processes to support=
 our efforts.</p>
